notes: Blocking vs lesser. The blocker (null McNemar and 'team beats single' wording) is fixed and verified against my own recomputation. None of the points below is a real result bug, so none blocks; all are carried forward. (1) Guard coverage: the narrowed patterns no longer flag the bare sentence 'Ignore your instructions.' or several other plain injections I tried, which the first patterns caught. The 16 dev injecting turns are all still caught and no dev card changes, but the record's known_misses list (one entry) does not mention these, and the catch rate on dev is not held out because the patterns were written from those turns. Several ordinary phrases still flag (answer/print/claim/'stop following the rules of'), so the fresh false-drop figure in the record should be read as a lower bound on real talk. (2) The rebuilt E2 cloud record writes claude_calls 0 although its predictions came from 164 Sonnet calls; config.rebuilt.claude_calls_of_the_source_record records 164 and the shared call counter is separate, but anyone reading the top-level field alone would undercount. Suggest T9.1 or the claims route sum the source's count for cloud rebuilds. (3) false_alert_rate comparisons still save mcnemar_p null in the E4 and E3 consistency records; DECISIONS 37 and docs/PLAN.md (From T4.2, for E8/T9.1) carry it forward. (4) answer_when_answerable counts non-abstention, not correctness; no resume claim may call it answer quality. The team's 4 vs 0 is not significant (p=0.125). (5) The cascade/consistency records' labels_reviewed flag flipped to true on rebuild because write_run now reads the H2 state and the publisher rule; that is by the documented rule, but docs/TESTING.md line 50 still says publisher is false while line 22 says reviewed (doc inconsistency). (6) Hand-read file quotes a few generic words from the false alarms (a 4-word reaction phrase and negation words); test_no_raw_text passes, so I count it as acceptable. (7) The rebuilt DECODE-source prediction files are 4 more tracked copies of rows already tracked in the source record; if DECODE-derived row text is not allowed in git, that is an existing T4.2 issue, not new, and the repo's text test passes. (8) A long-running tamper script of mine (orchestration/evidence/tmp-T4.2/tamper.py) was left to finish on its own; it only reads files. Not independently rerun: the full test_e3.py (relied on the gate log, 92 passed at this commit) and a model-level check of how the narrowed guard changes a live agent (no model calls allowed).
